# BigQuery ring classification after geography construction and snapping.

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 1 1, 0 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 2 0, 0 0)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 2, 0 2, 2 0, 0 0)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 1 1, 0 2, 1 1, 0 0)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(170 0, -170 0, 180 10, 170 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 80, 120 80, -120 80, 0 80)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 0, 2 0, 1 1, 0 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 1 1, 0.000000000001 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 2 0, 1 1, 0 0), (10 0, 12 0, 11 1, 10 0))'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(5 5), LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 1 1, 0 0))'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0, -2 0, -2 -2, 0 -2, 0 0)'))
=> "false"


# BigQuery geography function documentation: non-linestring and empty inputs are not rings.

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(0 0)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0))'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISRING(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null
